name: Basilica of Mary, Queen of the Universe
history: The shrine was founded to serve the many Catholic tourists visiting Orlando's attractions. Land was bought in 1979 and the first phase, with a bell tower, was blessed in 1986. The main church was dedicated on 22 August 1993. Benedict XVI named it a basilica in 2009 for its ministry to about half a million pilgrims and tourists a year.
arch: A modern 2,000-seat church with an arcaded entrance and a tall freestanding bell tower, set among the Rosary Garden and an outdoor chapel.
features: The fourteen aisle windows are called the Magnificat Windows.
The shrine also serves Catholic workers at Walt Disney World, Universal and SeaWorld.

look.d: The bell tower was part of the first phase, blessed in 1986.
Built for travellers: tourists are its parish.

fun: It was the 63rd minor basilica in the U.S.
journal: A basilica for the theme-park crowd. Sunburnt pilgrims welcome.
